task: A portfolio has two assets: 30 units at price 50, and 10 units at price 200 (total value 3500). Total borrowed = 1400. Compute loan-to-value in basis points = borrowed*10000/total_value with truncating integer division (equals 4000). Store the integer as answer. When achieved, evaluate (final true).
lesson: Today I learned `rlm-set` requires the answer variable as the first argument, not the second.
